title: Chapter 305 Battle Of The Pass
content:
Chapter 305 Battle Of The Pass

Half an hour later, few parts of the city wall were intact.

Wagner was helpless!

Rushing out now is tantamount to starting a decisive battle. He has only more than 2,000 elite soldiers and 20,000 miscellaneous soldiers in his hands at this time. If he fights the opposite army in a decisive battle, he will definitely lose.

If he fails to complete the task given by the bloodthirsty demon wolf, his fate will be equally miserable, and the lessons learned from his past are still fresh in his mind!

Now we can only delay it as long as we can.

Wagner wanted to delay, but the human coalition forces on the opposite side didn't want to!

"Come on!"

Wang Shuo did not hide behind the crowd, but took the lead in rushing forward with the Hell Knights.

The three-headed dog has healing skills and its vitality is still very tenacious.

Therefore, taking the lead in the charge is not considered sacrificing one's life.

In this battle, there were nearly 10 mayors and lords working together, and each of them sent nearly a thousand ace troops.

The levels of these main forces are all close to level 40, and their equipment is quite luxurious. They are considered the ace among aces.

Although the main force of the Burning Legion is of high level, there are still a large number of miscellaneous soldiers of level 20 to 30.

More importantly, the undead have almost no armor other than weapons.

Of course, their bones are equivalent to their armor.

The war broke out in an instant.

On the human coalition side, the number of mid- to high-level generals was far greater than that of the undead army. As soon as the battle began, the undead army fell into a passive position.

Wagner also has no generals available.

There are only more than 100 junior generals, and more than half of them have been lost in the previous war.

For fierce generals like Wang Shuo and Gong Zheng, almost no undead can stop them.

A fierce fight unfolded in the river valley.

Corpses littered the fields and rivers of blood flowed.

An hour later, Wagner was finally defeated and began to retreat.

This battle can be said to be extremely tragic. The human troops lost nearly 5,000 people.

Wang Shuo's Red Flame Army also lost nearly 300 people.

Other mayors and lords suffered higher losses than him.

Standing among the corpses, Wang Shuo was deeply shocked.

this--

It's a battlefield! !

But this is not the time to be sad.

"Everyone, now is the best time to completely defeat this undead army. We must not let them go to join the bloodthirsty demon wolf."

"Mayor Wang is right." Su Xiu finally had a sense of presence.

In the previous battle, his White Horse Knights did not perform too well.

Now in this kind of pursuit battle, where he beats the drowned dog, he must perform well to show his strength in front of the various mayors and lords, otherwise he will have no say in the future.

Wang Shuo was also unambiguous and directly asked his three ace troops, together with the brother troops of the Nanshan Society, to pursue the escaped undead troops directly.

Killing the undead not only brings benefits such as energy crystals, but also increases the level, killing two birds with one stone.

After several battles, the average level of the Red Flame Army has reached level 41.

Wang Shuo discovered a problem at this time.

It's just that my own level doesn't rise as fast as that of ordinary soldiers.

Is it because he is a military commander?

Riding on Rhubarb's back, Wang Shuo turned to look at Ayub. He was only level 40 at this time. Although he was higher than himself, his improvement speed was obviously not as good as that of some soldiers.

Because the highest-level soldiers are already level 43.

Really unable to understand this problem, Wang Shuo did not dwell too much on it, because at this time, they had already caught up with the undead who were lagging behind.

There are probably more than 8,000 undead who escaped.

Wagner was among them, and Wang Shuo's target for this trip was the enemy commander Wagner.
